austin.summary: Austin, you drafted dead last in the snake order and somehow walked away with a wall. Four of 4 still in the game, 16 counted points, tied for rank 1 of 5, and two badges on the mantel: Untouchable — 4 boots, none yours — and Wire-to-Wire, because you've led or co-led after every single elimination. Ep 3 gave you +8, your best week yet. Draft GPA sits at 3.75. That, my friend, is a quiet masterpiece.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Linnea, Jenna, Carter and Eric are each sitting on 4 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced roster where Eric at pick #16 is the steal of the draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: You haven't lost a castaway yet, so the only soft spot is Linnea's B grade in a lineup where everyone else earned an A.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are 98 points still on the table and the leader has 16 — so watch whether Jenna's years of planning and Eric's fast-built bonds keep this four-headed monster co-leading after the next elimination.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this season — Aaliyah went home in Episode 1, you earned the First Blood badge, and Episode 1 was your worst week at +3. But look at the scoreboard: rank 5 of 5 with 12 counted points, and the leader has 16. That's nothing. Three of your four are still out there, Episode 3 gave you +6, and 76 points are still sitting on the table. You're in contention.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian, Alexis and Kilby are all sitting at 4 pts and all three rank 1 of 21 — a perfectly balanced engine room of A grades.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was your reach, the first boot of the season, and she finished with 0 pts and a grade of F at rank 21 of 21.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Kilby at pick #18 is your steal of the draft — the game designer thinking three steps ahead, with Cristian on Dina alongside him.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick in the snake and you built a team that refuses to go quietly. You sit rank 3 of 5 with 15 counted points — raw 17, with Rob dropped under the best-4 rule — and the leader has just 16. Three of your five are still in the game, your Ep 3 was a +7, and 76 points are still on the table. You are absolutely in this.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda Cox was your leftover at pick #21 and she's sitting at 4 pts, rank 1 of 21, grade A — the steal of this entire draft, with Jelly and Mike right there beside her at 4 pts apiece.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 was the reach — 3 pts, rank 18 of 21, grade F, third voted out in Ep 3 — and Rob's quit the same episode is why your Torch Collector badge has 2 torches snuffed and your draft GPA reads 2.4.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You hold the Idol Whisperer badge with 2 idols and advantages found across the roster — keep your eye on whether Jelly, Mike, and Sharonda turn that hardware into points while the leader's 16 stays within reach.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and built something sturdy: a crisis manager, a personal trainer, and a pro wrestler, three of your four still in the game. You sit rank 4 of 5 with 13 counted points, the leader has 16, and there are 76 points still on the table — that is nothing. Ep 3 gave you a +6, your best week yet. The draft GPA reads 2.5, early days. Stay close, Taylor. This thing is wide open.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin, Ori, and Brady are each sitting on 4 pts and ranked 1 of 21 — a three-headed engine hauling your team up the leaderboard.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani, your pick #12, went out 2nd in Ep 2 with 1 pts and a rank of 20 of 21 — an F on the board and a reach you'd like back.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Brady at pick #19 is the steal of this draft, and whether that late-round wrestler keeps delivering is the storyline that decides your season.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted 4th and somehow walked away with an entire tribe. Four castaways, all Toka, all still in the game at 4 of 4, all sitting at 4 pts and rank 1 of 21 — that's a clean sweep of a roster. You're tied at rank 1 of 5 with 16 counted points, you've gone Wire-to-Wire, and you're Untouchable: 4 boots, none of them yours. Ep 3 gave you +8. The tribe is yours. For now.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An are each at 4 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, with Thien An at pick #17 standing as the steal of your draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Every name you own wears the same buff, so Toka's fortunes are your fortunes, and Lewis Kelly's B grade is the softest mark on an otherwise A-heavy board.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are 98 points still on the table and the leader has 16 — watch whether that Untouchable badge survives the first time Toka has to make a hard call.
